# Klar

Klar builds and runs the digital side of independent restaurants in Finland: your own website, your own online ordering and your own table bookings, with the guest list staying yours. Delivery apps take up to 30% of an order and booking platforms charge a fee per cover; Klar charges one flat monthly fee and 0% commission on sales. Based in Helsinki, serving Finland. Sites go live within 7 days, and hosting, same-day content changes, Google Business Profile care and a monthly report are included.

Klar Complete (website, ordering, bookings, guest CRM and SEO together) is priced by usage: Klar 300 at EUR 249/month, Klar 750 at EUR 399/month and Klar 1500 at EUR 799/month. Bookings alone is EUR 149/month and ordering alone EUR 199/month, each on a EUR 1,900-2,600 setup. Website and SEO on its own is a EUR 1,490 one-time setup then EUR 49/month. Above 1,500 orders and booked guests a month, or more than one location, the tier is Klar Enterprise, which is quoted per deal and has no published price.

On the season model the monthly fee runs from 1 May to 30 September only, in five instalments a year; from 1 October to 30 April it is EUR 0 and nothing is switched off. Setup is cut 40% to EUR 1,440-1,560, paid at signature either 50/50 or across one to three instalments, and the agreement runs two years. The month of signature decides how many months pass before the first invoice: sign in October and seven months pass, sign in May and none do.

All prices exclude VAT, which is added at Finland's 25.5%.

- [Pricing](https://klarsystems.com/pricing/): The season model, the Klar 300 / 750 / 1500 usage bands at EUR 249 / 399 / 799 a month, Klar Enterprise as contact-sales rather than a price, what decides the setup fee, and the scale that turns the signing month into fee-free months.

- [Contact](https://klarsystems.com/contact/): How to reach Klar, and the free 30-minute visit to your restaurant in the Helsinki region.
